newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.1 bln for Wednesday, March 26.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.1 bln for Wednesday, March 26.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, March 26 are expected to total $1.1 billion in 30 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $921 million in 19 sales, with a $600 million Hawaii deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 11 sales totaling $164 million are on the schedule, a $45 million Oakland, Calif., deal at 1300 EST is the largest.
An additional six sales totaling $352 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday, depending on market conditions.
